title: Papyrus marketing site: 'Built with Papyrus' showcase page with a logo wall
description: Ryan, 2026-10-20: the Papyrus marketing site (p.apyr.us product site, not the Papyrus publication) gets a page that proudly lists every site built on Papyrus, as a logo wall for social proof. Sites with a logo show the logo; others show the name. Honest framing: today almost all are Anthus's own sites (say so); design partners get featured as they join, then paying customers. The list is data managed in the CMS (one record per site: name, logo, URL, kind = Anthus / design partner / customer, ordering), not hard-coded, so new logos can be added without code. Built on the standard front end (a core 'showcase/logo wall' component usable by any site).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done and live: https://p.apyr.us/built-with/ (core logo wall, data in content/showcase/*.md: name, logo or text fallback, url, kind, order). Lists 8 live sites (Papyrus, Anth.us, Pilobol.us, Distinctive Mark, Threat Intelligence, Prospectus, Markus docs, Biblicus docs), all 200 when checked; real logos from the repos for 5, text fallback for Pilobol.us and Markus docs. Linked from nav and footer. Hybrid sites (Chatticus, Cyclotron, Tactus) not listed: only part of their pages render through Papyrus; add a record to include them.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Showcase tiles now show name and optional description under the logo (Papyrus #451, #454; release 5.8.1 on npm and PyPI). Papyrus-web #12: description on every entry, nine more live sites added with real logos, pinned 5.8.1, deployed; verified at 1440 and 390.
